profile.headline: Software Engineering Apprentice @ Niantic
profile.summary:
Having worked as an auditor and a CPA accountant for five years, I have experience developing and customize financial solutions to meet business needs, helping them meet compliance requirements and improve budgets. However, from working closely with privately enterprises, I realized many of them have not taken advantage of technology to improve economics of sale, which led to productivity and monetary loss.

With extensive graduate-level training in statistics, I have taught myself computer programming and apply structured problem solving to automate and develop applications. That process led me to software development. I am seeking a software development position where I can continue develop my technical skills, build useful applications to help business leverage technology while being intuitive for users.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Apprentice
positions.description:
AR Mapping Team
Skills: React - Node.JS - Typescript - MUI

positions.title: Full-stack Java Development Bootcamp Student
positions.description:
A full-stack Java coding bootcamp to learn how to develop dynamic web-based software systems using the Java programming language and platform with 700+ hours of lecture and application including:

Object-Oriented Programming: Java
Web Application Development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Spring Boot, Vue.js
Database Programming: JDBC, Table Design, SQL, PostgreSQL, E/R diagrams
Development Tools and Techniques: Agile, Unit Testing (JUnit), Integration Testing, Unix Command Line navigation, Git, IntelliJ

positions.title: Senior Accountant
positions.description:
- Performed assurance services for private clients in accordance with Accounting Standards for Private Enterprise (ASPE).
- Provided value-adding services to owner-managed businesses through compilation engagements and advisory related to financial reporting and tax restructuring.
- Supervised & reviewed works of junior staffs, completed engagements before deadlines and received positive feedbacks from clients.
- Successfully passed National CPA Exam on September 2020 at first attempt with depth and breath in all competencies.

positions.title: Senior Accountant
positions.description:
- Performed assurance & tax consulting services in compliance with ASPE, demonstrated excellent attention to details, team work & customer services.
- Prepared corporate tax returns, tax research & wrote memos for internal use under time budget & resulting in tax savings to clients.

company.name: Weir and Company Chartered Professional Accountants LLP

positions.title: Financial Analyst
positions.description:
- Monitored general ledger of +400 accounts, revenue and expenditures against budgets, analyze financial implications & addressed unexpected variances promptly.
- Produced and automated monthly, quarterly, annual financial statements and variance analysis for balance sheet.
- Resolved financial inquiries from business partners and internal staffs with 100% satisfaction rate.
- Collaborated with department personnel to troubleshooting billing system & payroll processing.
